name: Higher-Layer Connectivity Diagnostics
description: Identify browser, VPN, proxy, security-software, and application-specific connectivity conditions after core networking passes.

identify_remaining_scope.question: What is still unable to connect?
identify_remaining_scope.help_text: Core IP, gateway, and DNS checks have passed. Choose the closest remaining symptom so Gnojo can compare higher-layer behavior without repeating those checks.

broad_or_unsure.label: Several services, or I'm not sure

compare_browser_access.title: Compare Browser and Website Access
compare_browser_access.instruction: Try the affected website in a private browsing window and in another available browser. Then try a second known working website. Record whether the failure follows one website, one browser, or all browser traffic.
compare_browser_access.help_text: This comparison separates a site-specific or browser-specific condition from a broader higher-layer connection problem. Do not clear saved passwords, cookies, or browser data during this check.

browser_result.question: Did the website work in another browser or private window?

compare_vpn_proxy_access.title: Compare VPN or Proxy Access
compare_vpn_proxy_access.instruction: Record the configured VPN or proxy and its current status. If policy permits, disconnect the VPN without removing its profile and test an ordinary approved website. Do not change organization-managed proxy or VPN settings.
compare_vpn_proxy_access.help_text: This comparison checks whether ordinary web access works outside the affected VPN session while preserving managed configuration.

vpn_proxy_result.question: Does ordinary approved web access work when the affected VPN is disconnected?

no.label: No or the comparison is not permitted

compare_application_access.title: Compare Application Connectivity
compare_application_access.instruction: Keep the affected application open and test an approved website or another network-enabled application. Record whether only the original application fails and capture its exact error message.
compare_application_access.help_text: A successful comparison provides evidence that the remaining condition is specific to the application rather than the core network path.

application_result.question: Can another website or network-enabled application connect?

inspect_security_controls.title: Inspect Security and Filtering Evidence
inspect_security_controls.instruction: Review visible firewall, endpoint-security, VPN, proxy, and browser warning messages for the affected destination or application. Record any blocked connection, certificate, authentication, or policy event. Do not disable security software or change managed policies.
inspect_security_controls.help_text: This read-only review looks for evidence that a higher-layer security or filtering control is handling the connection after core networking has passed.

security_result.question: Did a security, filtering, certificate, or policy message identify the blocked connection?

browser_condition.title: Browser- or Website-Specific Condition
browser_condition.message: Core networking works and the comparison succeeded outside the original browser context. Review the affected browser's extension, privacy, certificate, cache, and site-specific settings before changing network configuration.

vpn_proxy_condition.title: VPN or Proxy Condition Identified
vpn_proxy_condition.message: Ordinary web access works outside the affected VPN session. Preserve the current configuration and review VPN authentication, certificates, routes, proxy policy, and service status with the appropriate support owner.

application_condition.title: Application-Specific Connectivity Condition
application_condition.message: Other network-enabled software can connect, so the remaining condition is specific to the affected application. Review its account, service endpoint, certificate, proxy, and application-level network settings using the recorded error.

security_condition.title: Security or Filtering Condition Identified
security_condition.message: A firewall, endpoint-security, certificate, proxy, or policy message identified the affected connection. Record the event and have the appropriate administrator review the rule or policy rather than disabling protection.

higher_layer_review.title: Higher-Layer Connectivity Review Needed
higher_layer_review.message: Core networking works, but the comparison did not isolate the remaining condition. Preserve the affected destination, application, time, and exact error so a technician can review authentication, certificates, filtering, service availability, and application-specific behavior.
